description: Current coverage only. Whole-job release-stage entries inventory every executable step; publication policy and incident entries name narrower counterparts. Policy tests do not prove live publication or actual-archive upgrade. followUp 1581 marks gaps to close with the separately approved rehearsal PR.

plan.releaseOnly: Preparation and draft/recovery admission are main-only. No PR counterpart resolves live draft state; tagless PR preparation is deferred to #1581 rehearsal.

bundle.releaseOnly: The complete per-product four-host pipeline is not called before merge. Its child jobs are inventoried separately; selected PR preparation is deferred to #1581 rehearsal.

check.releaseOnly: Admission re-reads a live draft and its failure/bundle markers immediately before building; those mutation races exist only in the allocated release pipeline.

prepare.releaseOnly: Draft admission (check) and the main-only condition gate this call; its jobs are inventoried under native-release-prepare.yml. Before merge, ci.yml's release-rehearsal job runs the same prepare workflow for the products whose release inputs a PR changes (never in the merge group) and release-rehearsal.yml runs every active product nightly on main; mapping these rows to that counterpart is deferred to #1581 B3.

steps: name:Attach the bundle to the draft release
attach.releaseOnly: Uploading to a real draft, re-reading asset digests and attaching the completeness marker require an allocated draft and publication privileges.

steps: name:Record the failure on the draft release
record-failure.releaseOnly: The durable failure marker is a write to a real allocated draft; pre-merge tests cover the marker policy without performing this write.

steps: name:Restore dependency cache for locked source acquisition
gates.releaseOnly: Live checks consume allocated-tag, merged-main, completed PR check-suite and published-release state. Pure policy tests are mapped separately; dry candidate evaluation is deferred to #1581 rehearsal.

upgrade.releaseOnly: The called upgrade workflow currently requires a GitHub draft or published candidate tag. Locally staged rehearsal candidate inputs are deferred to #1581 rehearsal.

finish.releaseOnly: The decision removes or preserves the real draft hold marker after the live upgrade outcome; policy tests do not attest that live state transition.

steps: name:Publish the draft under the product's policy
publish.releaseOnly: Publishing the allocated immutable release is an authorized side effect that cannot happen in pre-merge verification.

steps: name:Check immutability, flags, tag and attestation of the published release
published.releaseOnly: Public immutable flags, exact tag ancestry and GitHub release/asset attestations can only be read back after publication.

smoke.releaseOnly: The public URLs and release metadata under test exist only after publication. Matching-host candidate installation/upgrade remains a separate rehearsal gap.

project-release.releaseOnly: Dispatching the Project sweep changes delivery tracking after publication and successful public smoke; it is not a pre-merge release verification gate.

steps: name:Build release archive and target manifest
name:Verify plan, archive and binary versions against the injected tag
name:Recheck version-only source after this stage
build.releaseOnly: The injection PR workflow builds synthetic archives on four hosts for its own narrow workflow paths. It does not select the full release packaging input set; affected-product preparation is deferred to #1581 rehearsal.

steps: name:Merge with cargo-dist and verify bootstrap inputs
name:Recheck version-only source after this stage
assemble.releaseOnly: No PR job merges all four cargo-dist target manifests, generates the complete bootstrap and checks the version-only source contract on that final bundle. Shared preparation is deferred to #1581 rehearsal.

steps: name:Install pinned Rust for version-only resolution
name:Build independent expected Colab app bytes
name:Execute final archive and bootstrap with the matching target process
name:Recheck version-only source after this stage
verify.releaseOnly: Raw runtime/injection PR proofs do not execute the assembled final bundle on four hosts. Independent Colab frontend comparison, combined notices and Rosetta final verification are deferred to #1581 rehearsal.

steps: name:Download and check the release assets
name:Hand the assets to the proof
fetch.releaseOnly: The current fetch path reads an actual draft/published candidate and stages digest-checked previous releases. A read-only local candidate artifact adapter is deferred to #1581 rehearsal.

steps: name:Install Rust for version-only resolution and adapter acceptance
name:Restore Rust dependencies for version-only resolution and adapter acceptance
name:Inject the reviewed draft version for upgrade proof and #575 acceptance
name:Prove last-published and declared-floor installation and bootstrap recovery
name:Prove the real-archive CLI upgrade adapter
name:Recheck version-only source after runtime proof and adapter acceptance
name:Keep the log of a failed proof
prove.releaseOnly: Native process fixtures test installer behavior, but no persistent selected PR job runs this four-host actual release-archive/support-floor and CLI adapter proof. This is deferred to #1581 rehearsal.

steps: name:Fail a release the proof cannot run for
conclude.releaseOnly: This job must reflect the actual matching-host upgrade results and reject unavailable proof; a pre-merge equivalent depends on the #1581 rehearsal upgrade path.

smoke.releaseOnly: Public bootstrap and native acquisition validate the just-published immutable release through real public URLs; that candidate cannot be fetched publicly before publication.

report.releaseOnly: Opening/updating a failure issue is a post-publication reporting side effect; it does not establish candidate verification.

steps: name:Install reviewed release parsing and rendering dependencies
name:Restore dependency cache for locked source acquisition
name:Draft immutable source cuts and dispatch their native gates
cut.releaseOnly: Cadence, draft visibility and concurrent allocation/recovery admission depend on live main/release state. The pure cut planner is tested pre-merge, but selected candidate dry planning is deferred to #1581 rehearsal.

release.step: name:Execute final archive and bootstrap with the matching target process

1534.releaseOnly: Existing injection PR builds verify archive versions but do not execute the complete Intel final verifier process tree after injection under Rosetta. The matching-host shared final-bundle rehearsal remains required.

release.step: name:Build independent expected Colab app bytes

1541.releaseOnly: PR Code quality builds the real Colab app and checks entry dependencies (#1604); it does not rebuild independent expected bytes and compare them with a released final archive on all matching hosts.

release.step: name:Execute final archive and bootstrap with the matching target process
